preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n must be between 1 and 300000.
The length of the permutation must equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation must be integers between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation must be unique.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a pair of integers a, b such that a < b and there is an element c in the permutation where a < c < b or b < c < a, otherwise output 'NO'.
postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a < c < b or b < c < a for a, b in zip(permutation, permutation[1:]) for c in permutation if a != c != b) else stdout == 'NO'
